name: The Unkillable King
source:
You are the newly coronated king of Vylesia. While you fulfill your duties ruling your kingdom, something... strange, has been affecting you. You are plagued by nightmares and followed by a dark entity with unclear motives. With your declining physical and mental health influencing your decisions, will you manage to cure yourself of the affliction or go mad from the illness?

[From [url=https://bugboyy.itch.io/the-unkillable-king]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是维莱西亚刚刚加冕的国王。一边履行治国的职责，一边又有什么…奇怪的东西，在影响着你。噩梦纠缠不放，一个来意不明的黑暗存在也总跟在身后。身心状况日益恶化，连你做的决定都受到影响。你能设法治好这怪病吗？还是会在折磨中发疯？

［摘自[url=https://bugboyy.itch.io/the-unkillable-king]itch.io[/url]］
